label: Phase two — the lesson begins

recentEvents.value: He recited the envoy's rites in full; the stranger heard every word and answered in clichés about judgment. The prince has started taking notes.

unresolvedConflicts.value: The only fighter he has ever watched is the man destroying his court.

temporaryObjective.value: Watch: stance, grip, timing. If this is a lesson, learn it faster than it is taught.

notes: 'You understand every word I say, don't you? Then this is a lesson, and I had better learn it.'
